hermes_risk_feed.summary: Hawkish FOMC minutes confirmed that most Fed officials expect another interest rate hike this year to combat persistent inflation risks. Meanwhile, elevated US 10-Year Treasury yields above 5.27% continue to apply severe tightening pressure across global risk assets.
